Team —

We have a concentrated interview batch for the Runtime Team next Thu–Sat (3/18–3/20). TalentScout is sending in 7 screened candidates; we need to make sure panel coverage is balanced, avoid repeated interviewer load, and have at least one paired shadow per loop for calibration.

Quick ask: can each of you take the slots below (see attached slot_matrix.xlsx for the full grid)? If you can’t, reply with the ones you *cannot* take and any preference for pairing (algorithms, infra, systems design). I’ll consolidate and send final calendar invites.

High-level constraints:
- Avoid assigning the same primary interviewer to more than 3 loops across the three days.
- Pair a senior+IC for the systems-design loops (candidate deep-dive).
- Prefer east-coast-friendly times for candidates in EST (they’re in US), but we’ll need 2 late-Pacific slots for overflow.

Proposed high-load slots (all PT):
- Thu 3/18: 9:00–11:30 (3 loops)
- Fri 3/19: 12:00–16:00 (4 loops)
- Sat 3/20: 09:00–13:00 (2 loops, on-call weekend coverage)

Attachments: slot_matrix.xlsx (contains per-candidate preferred windows), candidate_prep.pdf (one-pagers).

TalentScout — can you confirm candidate interview windows are locked by tomorrow EOD so we can finalize?

Thanks,
